Senior Marketing Analyst - Northwind Outdoor (anonymized test posting)

About the role
You'll join the Growth team and work alongside our product management team to understand what
drives customer acquisition and retention across our retail and online channels.

Responsibilities
- Analyze campaign and customer data to find growth opportunities.
- Build recurring reporting for marketing leadership.
- Partner with merchandising and product teams on launch plans.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, or a related field.
- Advanced SQL for analysis of large customer datasets.
- Experience with Snowflake.
- Proven project management experience leading cross-team launches.
- PM experience partnering with engineering on product roadmaps.
- Active CPA license.
- 4+ years of marketing analytics experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Tableau dashboards for executive audiences.
- Experience with Salesforce campaign data.

Northwind Outdoor is an equal opportunity employer.
